title: Money domain observations (map densify)
description: Recent OCP awards (+ open RFPs) with compact place stamps for the map money lens. Place is derived from title/body/agency signals; most contracts are genuinely non-spatial or citywide service classes.
place_stamp_note: place is a compact derivation stamp (scope/boroughs/methods). Raw award body is not committed.
